name: Mistral Studio
desc: Mistral's workbench for building, testing and running agents and apps.
desc_zh: Mistral 用于构建、测试和运行智能体与应用的开发平台。
solves: You only find out what's wrong with an agent after it ships. Studio lets you run it while you build, read the evaluation results, and go back and fix things.
solves_zh: 智能体写完只能上线才知道哪里不对。Studio 让你边搭边跑，还能看评估结果再回头改。
best_for: You are tuning an agent flow and need to retry each step's inputs and outputs repeatedly.
best_for_zh: 你在调一条智能体流程，要反复试各步骤的输入输出。
notes: Mistral's counterpart to Google AI Studio and Anthropic's console workbench; the ledger had only the API tier recorded. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://mistral.ai
